## 📋 Overview

-   **Instructors:** Abe Hofman, Lilian Ye, Annie Johansson\
-   **Dates:** September 29th - October 11th, 2026\
-   **Format:** Lectures + Tutorials
-   **Main Topics:**
    -   Effective data visualization\
    -   ggplot
    -   Working with AI in a data viz workflow
    -   Git & GitHub for collaboration

In this module, you will learn a wide set of data visualisation tools for both static and interactive visualizations. We will also focus on why you should look at your data and what makes a good visualization. You will work with real, open data from [DUO](https://duo.nl/open_onderwijsdata/) (the Dutch education executive agency) to design visualizations from.
